The `pexl` Python package supports structured access to PEExcel project data, validation and analysis. It complements the Excel application; it does not replace project-specific input checks or declaration quality assurance.

## Available notebooks

- [Read and inspect an Excel export](../downloads/howto_excel.ipynb)
- [Analyse hourly electricity balances](../downloads/howto_analyze_electricity_balance.ipynb)
- [Visualise district projects](../downloads/howto_visualize_project.ipynb)
- [Build the component catalogue and section renderer](../downloads/howto_section_teaching_preview.ipynb)
- [Build the Quarto site](../downloads/howto_website.ipynb)

The site embeds read-only notebook views. Download a notebook to execute it in the repository environment; published notebook views do not run code.

## Example: render a result

```python
from pexl import Project, reporting
from pexl.plot import plotly
from pexl.plot.export import export_figure

project = Project.from_excel("data/exports/example.xlsx")
figure = plotly.render(reporting.materialize(project.view, "primary_energy_balance"))
export_figure(figure, "primary_energy_balance", formats=("html", "svg", "png"))
```

Use the same `pexl` reporting and plotting functions as the publication workflow. Record source file, scenario, tool version and export provenance with results.
